s0101.literal: On jiazi day the Annam king's son Ni Huan was sent home.
s0101.idiomatic: On jiazi day the Annam king's son Ni Huan was sent home.

s0102.literal: Adult males of the Mongol army were registered.
s0102.idiomatic: Adult males of the Mongol army were registered.

s0103.literal: An edict ordered Yilai and others to lead ten thousand men into Luoshi Ghost Country; if they did not submit, they were to enter and suppress them.
s0103.idiomatic: An edict ordered Yilai and others to lead ten thousand men into Luoshi Ghost Country; if the country did not submit, they were to enter and suppress it.

s0104.literal: On yichou day the Jiangnan revenue chief commissioner's office was abolished.
s0104.idiomatic: On yichou day the Jiangnan revenue chief commissioner's office was abolished.

s0105.literal: On dingmao day the Dadu salt transport commission was merged with Hejian into one office, and redundant personnel were reduced.
s0105.idiomatic: On dingmao day the Dadu salt transport commission was merged with Hejian into one office, and redundant personnel were cut.

s0106.literal: Twenty thousand households of Jiankang commoners were assigned to grow rice, yielding thirty thousand shi of brewing rice annually, transported to the capital by the state.
s0106.idiomatic: Twenty thousand Jiankang households were assigned to grow rice, yielding 30,000 shi of brewing rice each year for transport to the capital by the state.

s0107.literal: On wuchen day an edict ordered the registration of those who had previously volunteered for service and Zhang Shijie's routed troops, to be sent to campaign against Japan.
s0107.idiomatic: On wuchen day an edict ordered the registration of earlier volunteers for service and Zhang Shijie's routed troops for the campaign against Japan.

s0108.literal: Fan Wenhu and others were ordered to gather Mongol, Muslim, and other troops who had taken refuge with Song to avoid punishment.
s0108.idiomatic: Fan Wenhu and others were ordered to gather Mongol, Muslim, and other troops who had joined Song to avoid punishment.

s0109.literal: On jisi day a palace envoy Yanan was dispatched to visit famous mountains in Jiangnan seeking recluses, and also ordered to carry incense and silks to Mount Longhu in Xin Prefecture, Mount Gezao in Linjiang, and Mount Sanmao in Jiankang, with libation rites established at each.
s0109.idiomatic: On jisi day palace envoy Yanan was sent to visit famous mountains in Jiangnan seeking recluses, and also to carry incense and silks to Mount Longhu in Xin Prefecture, Mount Gezao in Linjiang, and Mount Sanmao in Jiankang, with libation rites at each.

s0110.literal: Aqchihei and others and Keshigde and others were granted silver and paper currency for battle merit; officials of the Sanmao and other cave districts who had been recruited to submit were granted clothing and fabrics.
s0110.idiomatic: Aqchihei, Keshigde, and others received silver and paper currency for battle merit; officials of the Sanmao and other cave districts recruited to submit received clothing and fabrics.

s0111.literal: Eighth month, gengwu new moon: Xiao Jian and ten others had travelled through the five routes of Henan, privately recruiting escaped households; when the matter was discovered, the ringleaders were demoted to serve in the army to redeem themselves and the rest were caned.
s0111.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the gengwu new moon, Xiao Jian and ten others had travelled through the five Henan routes privately recruiting escaped households; when the matter came out, the ringleaders were demoted to army service to redeem themselves and the rest were caned.

s0112.literal: On yihai day the Mongol Guard commander's office was changed to the Mongol Guard Household Army metropolitan commanderate.
s0112.idiomatic: On yihai day the Mongol Guard commander's office was made the Mongol Guard Household Army metropolitan commanderate.

s0113.literal: On bingzi day the moon transgressed the eastern star of Xin.
s0113.idiomatic: On bingzi day the moon transgressed the eastern star of Xin.

s0114.literal: On dingchou day Suodu requested to summon the submission of Samboja and seven other states; this was not approved.
s0114.idiomatic: On dingchou day Suodu asked to summon the submission of Samboja and seven other states; the request was denied.

s0115.literal: Wanhu Lü Zonghai, garrisoning Nanjian Route, stole troops and fled; an edict ordered him pursued.
s0115.idiomatic: Wanhu Lü Zonghai, garrisoning Nanjian Route, stole troops and fled; an edict ordered him pursued.

s0116.literal: On wuyin day Champa and Ma'bar both dispatched envoys presenting memorials declaring themselves subjects and tribute of precious objects, rhinoceros horn, and elephants.
s0116.idiomatic: On wuyin day Champa and Ma'bar both sent envoys with memorials declaring themselves subjects and tribute of precious objects, rhinoceros horn, and elephants.

s0117.literal: Those previously registered as volunteers for service were made troops and placed under Chahu to campaign against Japan.
s0117.idiomatic: Those previously registered as volunteers for service were made troops and placed under Chahu for the campaign against Japan.

s0118.literal: On dinghai day Xu Heng retired from office; his son Shike was appointed route commander of Huaimeng so he could serve and support him.
s0118.idiomatic: On dinghai day Xu Heng retired; his son Shike was made route commander of Huaimeng so he could serve and support him.

s0119.literal: Six jadeite cups and fifteen white jade cups were submitted to the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0119.idiomatic: Six jadeite cups and fifteen white jade cups were submitted to the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0120.literal: On guisi day grain was granted to the forces under the Prince of Xiping.
s0120.idiomatic: On guisi day grain was granted to the forces under the Prince of Xiping.

s0121.literal: On wuxu day King Wang Chun of Goryeo came to court and said he would add thirty thousand troops to campaign against Japan.
s0121.idiomatic: On wuxu day King Wang Chun of Goryeo came to court and said he would add 30,000 troops to the campaign against Japan.

s0122.literal: Fan Wenhu, Xindu, and Hong Chajiu were made right vice chancellors of the Central Secretariat; Li Ting and Zhang Batuo were made associate administrators, all administering Central Secretariat affairs.
s0122.idiomatic: Fan Wenhu, Xindu, and Hong Chajiu were made right vice chancellors of the Central Secretariat; Li Ting and Zhang Batuo were made associate administrators, all administering Central Secretariat affairs.

s0123.literal: Paper currency was granted to Kuolijisi and others, sheep and horses to Miliwuge and others, price payments for cattle, sheep, and horses to Qielulian and others, and grain and silks to the keshig households of the Eastern Palace and others.
s0123.idiomatic: Paper currency was granted to Kuolijisi and others, sheep and horses to Miliwuge and others, price payments for cattle, sheep, and horses to Qielulian and others, and grain and silks to the Eastern Palace keshig households and others.

s0124.literal: Dadu, Beijing, Huaimeng, Baoding, Nanjing, Xuzhou, and Pingyang suffered drought; Puzhou, Dongping, Jining, and Cizhou suffered flooding.
s0124.idiomatic: Dadu, Beijing, Huaimeng, Baoding, Nanjing, Xuzhou, and Pingyang suffered drought; Puzhou, Dongping, Jining, and Cizhou flooded.

s0125.literal: Ninth month, renzi day: the imperial carriage returned from the Upper Capital.
s0125.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renzi day, the Emperor returned from the Upper Capital.

s0126.literal: On renxu day Yehaihan advanced to campaign against Otgon.
s0126.idiomatic: On renxu day Yehaihan advanced to campaign against Otgon.

s0127.literal: On guihai day orders directed that returning troops from Khara Kulgan be supplied grain at posts along the route.
s0127.idiomatic: On guihai day orders directed grain supplied at posts along the route to returning troops from Khara Kulgan.

s0128.literal: On jiazi day the moon eclipsed Right Regulator and also transgressed Jupiter.
s0128.idiomatic: On jiazi day the moon eclipsed Right Regulator and also transgressed Jupiter.

s0129.literal: On yichou day garrison troops guarding the treasury stole treasury notes; Baraqchi divided the booty and let the thieves escape; an edict ordered them executed.
s0129.idiomatic: On yichou day garrison troops guarding the treasury stole treasury notes; Baraqchi divided the booty and let the thieves escape; an edict ordered them executed.

s0130.literal: On dingmao day the lord of Luoshi Ghost Country A Zha and Ali submitted; Anxi King's chancellor Li Dehui sent men to accompany them to audience.
s0130.idiomatic: On dingmao day the lord of Luoshi Ghost Country A Zha and Ali submitted; Anxi King's chancellor Li Dehui sent men to accompany them to audience.

s0131.literal: Sheep and horse price payments of twenty-eight thousand three hundred ingots were granted to Baraqchi and others, and three months' grain to the poor under Tuhun.
s0131.idiomatic: Sheep and horse price payments of 28,300 ingots were granted to Baraqchi and others, and three months' grain to the poor under Tuhun.

s0132.literal: Winter, tenth month, gengwu day: soldiers of Talabuqan's army who had fought the enemy fiercely were ordered granted land as reward.
s0132.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on gengwu day, soldiers of Talabuqan's army who had fought fiercely were ordered granted land as reward.

s0133.literal: On guiyou day King Wang Chun of Goryeo was additionally made Grand Preceptor of State with the same ceremonial as the Three Excellencies, left grand councillor of the Central Secretariat, and administrator of branch secretariat affairs.
s0133.idiomatic: On guiyou day King Wang Chun of Goryeo was additionally made grand preceptor of state with the ceremonial of the Three Excellencies, left grand councillor of the Central Secretariat, and administrator of branch secretariat affairs.

s0134.literal: On jiaxu day envoys were dispatched to register three thousand troops from Kaiyuan and other routes for the campaign against Japan.
s0134.idiomatic: On jiaxu day envoys were sent to register 3,000 troops from Kaiyuan and other routes for the campaign against Japan.

s0135.literal: On bingzi day a seal was granted to Prince Hokechi of Yunnan.
s0135.idiomatic: On bingzi day a seal was granted to Prince Hokechi of Yunnan.

s0136.literal: On dingchou day ten thousand Hunan troops were sent to attack Yixibuxue, and Yixibuxue submitted.
s0136.idiomatic: On dingchou day 10,000 Hunan troops were sent against Yixibuxue, and Yixibuxue submitted.

s0137.literal: On wuyin day one hundred thousand troops were dispatched, and Fan Wenhu was ordered to command them.
s0137.idiomatic: On wuyin day 100,000 troops were dispatched, and Fan Wenhu was ordered to command them.

s0138.literal: Paper currency and armor were granted to the newly submitted troops under right vice chancellor Hong Chajiu campaigning against Japan.
s0138.idiomatic: Paper currency and armor were granted to the newly submitted troops under right vice chancellor Hong Chajiu bound for Japan.

s0139.literal: On xinsi day a garrison-farming superintendency was established, rank 5b, to be placed at Liulin; one thousand three hundred fifty-five households of various categories were assigned to it, and the state supplied oxen, seed, and farm tools.
s0139.idiomatic: On xinsi day a garrison-farming superintendency was established at rank 5b and placed at Liulin; 1,355 households of various categories were assigned to it, and the state supplied oxen, seed, and farm tools.

s0140.literal: On renwu day an edict ordered the establishment of a branch secretariat in Shaanxi, Sichuan, and other places, with Buhua as right vice chancellor and Li Dehui and Wang Weizheng both as left vice chancellors.
s0140.idiomatic: On renwu day an edict ordered a branch secretariat established in Shaanxi, Sichuan, and other places, with Buhua as right vice chancellor and Li Dehui and Wang Weizheng as left vice chancellors.

s0141.literal: By this time Dehui had already died.
s0141.idiomatic: By this time Dehui had already died.

s0142.literal: On jiashen day Celestial Master Zhang Zongyan of Mount Longhu was ordered to court.
s0142.idiomatic: On jiashen day Celestial Master Zhang Zongyan of Mount Longhu was ordered to court.

s0143.literal: On jichou day Dusu was ordered to trace the Yellow River to its source.
s0143.idiomatic: On jichou day Dusu was ordered to trace the Yellow River to its source.

s0144.literal: On xinmao day Han troops were ordered to garrison-farm in Sha and Gan.
s0144.idiomatic: On xinmao day Han troops were ordered to garrison-farm in Sha and Gan.

s0145.literal: On renchen day Yixibuxue fell ill and sent his nephew to audience.
s0145.idiomatic: On renchen day Yixibuxue fell ill and sent his nephew to audience.

s0146.literal: The Emperor said: "Yixibuxue did not await orders but rashly conferred office on his nephew — this is no conduct of a subject.
s0146.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Yixibuxue did not await orders but rashly conferred office on his nephew — this is no conduct of a subject.

s0147.literal: Yixibuxue should be ordered out, and only then should the army return.
s0147.idiomatic: Yixibuxue should be ordered out, and only then should the army return.

s0148.literal: " On guisi day an edict directed the cities of He Prefecture to gather displaced commoners.
s0148.idiomatic: " On guisi day an edict directed the cities of He Prefecture to gather displaced commoners.

s0149.literal: On bingshen day an order directed that officials, after one month in office, should receive salary in the following month; those who neglected their duties were to be dismissed.
s0149.idiomatic: On bingshen day an order directed that officials receive salary only after one month in office; those who neglected their duties were to be dismissed.

s0150.literal: Envoys were dispatched to instruct Java and Jiaozhi.
s0150.idiomatic: Envoys were sent to instruct Java and Jiaozhi.

s0152.literal: Grain was supplied to Qielie and others.
s0152.idiomatic: Grain was supplied to Qielie and others.

s0153.literal: The poor of the Huocha household were granted relief.
s0153.idiomatic: The poor of the Huocha household received relief.

s0154.literal: Eleventh month, jihai new moon: Hanlin academician-expositor Helü Huosun and others said: "Kunlun, Ma'bar, Zhepo, Jiaozhi, and other countries have all dispatched envoys presenting memorials and ask for a written response.
s0154.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the jihai new moon, Hanlin academician-expositor Helü Huosun and others said, "Kunlun, Ma'bar, Zhepo, Jiaozhi, and other countries have all sent envoys with memorials and ask for a written response.

s0155.literal: " Approved, and Jiaozhi envoys were also granted official titles and bows, arrows, saddles, and bridles.
s0155.idiomatic: " The request was approved, and Jiaozhi envoys were also granted official titles and bows, arrows, saddles, and bridles.

s0156.literal: An edict was issued to summon and instruct Java.
s0156.idiomatic: An edict was issued to summon and instruct Java.

s0157.literal: On yisi day the Treasury Bureau was established to manage receipts and disbursements of gold and silver for the imperial seat, crown prince, empress dowager, and princes.
s0157.idiomatic: On yisi day the Treasury Bureau was established to manage gold and silver receipts and disbursements for the imperial seat, crown prince, empress dowager, and princes.

s0158.literal: An order directed separate workshops established to house child artisans; the poor among them were granted paper currency.
s0158.idiomatic: An order directed separate workshops established to house child artisans; the poor among them received paper currency.

s0159.literal: An edict declared: "For those guilty and sentenced to corvée, measure the distance of the journey;
s0159.idiomatic: An edict declared, "For those guilty and sentenced to corvée, measure the distance of the journey;

s0160.literal: those whose crimes merit death should be carefully reviewed and tried.
s0160.idiomatic: those whose crimes merit death should be carefully reviewed and tried.

s0161.literal: " On wushen day Central Secretariat officials deliberated: "To circulate the paper-currency system, rewards should chiefly be paid in silks and fabrics, and revenue quotas should chiefly be collected in notes.
s0161.idiomatic: " On wushen day Central Secretariat officials deliberated, "To circulate the paper-currency system, rewards should chiefly be paid in silks and fabrics, and revenue quotas should chiefly be collected in notes.

s0163.literal: " On gengxu day Helü Huosun was ordered to screen the Jiaozhi envoys; except those who could remain, the rest were all sent home.
s0163.idiomatic: " On gengxu day Helü Huosun was ordered to screen the Jiaozhi envoys; except those allowed to remain, the rest were all sent home.

s0164.literal: On xinhai day construction labor was ordered slowed.
s0164.idiomatic: On xinhai day construction labor was ordered slowed.

s0165.literal: On renzi day an edict instructed the envoys of Kunlun to come and submit.
s0165.idiomatic: On renzi day an edict instructed the envoys of Kunlun to come and submit.

s0166.literal: On jiayin day Jian Prefecture of Taiyuan Route presented six stalks of auspicious grain.
s0166.idiomatic: On jiayin day Jian Prefecture of Taiyuan Route presented six stalks of auspicious grain.

s0167.literal: On renxu day an edict ordered the Jiang-Huai branch secretariat to recruit skilled artisans.
s0167.idiomatic: On renxu day an edict ordered the Jiang-Huai branch secretariat to recruit skilled artisans.

s0168.literal: On jiazi day an edict promulgated the Granting the Seasons Calendar.
s0168.idiomatic: On jiazi day an edict promulgated the Granting the Seasons Calendar.

s0169.literal: On dingmao day an edict directed that because the people of Mogansun were poor, aside from granary and relay-station taxes and levies, their corvée was remitted for three years.
s0169.idiomatic: On dingmao day an edict directed that because the people of Mogansun were poor, aside from granary and relay-station taxes and levies, their corvée was remitted for three years.

s0170.literal: Pacification commissioners Jiaohua and Meng Qingyuan and others were again dispatched bearing edicts to instruct the king of Champa, ordering his son or a senior minister to court.
s0170.idiomatic: Pacification commissioners Jiaohua and Meng Qingyuan and others were again sent with edicts to instruct the king of Champa, ordering his son or a senior minister to court.

s0171.literal: An edict ordered additional salt-furnace households assigned to saltworks in Jiangnan, Jiangbei, Shaanxi, Hejian, and Shandong, and granted the Directorate of Palace Buildings artisan Lü Hela silver, paper currency, and silks.
s0171.idiomatic: An edict ordered additional salt-furnace households assigned to saltworks in Jiangnan, Jiangbei, Shaanxi, Hejian, and Shandong, and granted Directorate of Palace Buildings artisan Lü Hela silver, paper currency, and silks.

s0172.literal: Twelfth month, gengwu day: because Jiang-Huai branch secretariat grand councillor Alibo and left vice chancellor Yan Timur had on their own authority changed eight hundred appointed officials, divided left and right bureau officials themselves, cast silver and copper seals, and again disobeyed orders by not disbanding garrison troops, an edict ordered them executed.
s0172.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengwu day, because Jiang-Huai branch secretariat grand councillor Alibo and left vice chancellor Yan Timur had on their own authority changed 800 appointed officials, divided left and right bureau officials themselves, cast silver and copper seals, and again disobeyed orders by not disbanding garrison troops, an edict ordered them executed.

s0173.literal: On xinwei day seasoned-ticket troops were returned to garrison-farm at Xiangyang.
s0173.idiomatic: On xinwei day seasoned-ticket troops were returned to garrison-farm at Xiangyang.

s0174.literal: King Wang Chun of Goryeo led ten thousand troops, fifteen thousand sailors, nine hundred warships, and one hundred thousand shi of grain to campaign against Japan; battle gear, Goryeo armor, and padded battle jackets were supplied to right vice chancellor Hong Chajiu and others.
s0174.idiomatic: King Wang Chun of Goryeo led 10,000 troops, 15,000 sailors, 900 warships, and 100,000 shi of grain against Japan; battle gear, Goryeo armor, and padded battle jackets were supplied to right vice chancellor Hong Chajiu and others.

s0175.literal: All routes' troops campaigning against Japan were instructed to take the route through Goryeo and not disturb its people.
s0175.idiomatic: All routes' troops bound for Japan were instructed to take the route through Goryeo and not disturb its people.

s0176.literal: Goryeo associate director Jin Fangqing was made Eastern Campaign marshal; Privy Council deputy director Pu Qiu and Jin Zhouding were made wanhu commanding Goryeo troops in the campaign against Japan, each granted a tiger tally.
s0176.idiomatic: Goryeo associate director Jin Fangqing was made Eastern Campaign marshal; privy council deputy director Pu Qiu and Jin Zhouding were made wanhu commanding Goryeo troops against Japan, each with a tiger tally.

s0177.literal: On guiyou day King Wang Chun of Goryeo was made right grand councillor of the Central Secretariat.
s0177.idiomatic: On guiyou day King Wang Chun of Goryeo was made right grand councillor of the Central Secretariat.

s0178.literal: On jiaxu day the original tiger tallies of officers in the campaign against Japan were restored.
s0178.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the original tiger tallies of officers bound for Japan were restored.

s0179.literal: On dingchou day, following Husin's recommendation, because commoners owed relay-station corvée, ten households were to form one unit and the state would supply one horse; when it died, a replacement was to be purchased.
s0179.idiomatic: On dingchou day, following Husin's recommendation, because commoners owed relay-station corvée, ten households were to form one unit and the state would supply one horse; when it died, a replacement was to be purchased.

s0180.literal: On wuyin day the envoys to the Mulaq country, Sulaqman and others, were made pacification commissioners with gold tallies.
s0180.idiomatic: On wuyin day the envoys to the Mulaq country, Sulaqman and others, were made pacification commissioners with gold tallies.

s0181.literal: On jimao day bandits in Luoshi Ghost Country caused trouble and the roads of Si and Bo were blocked; one thousand troops were dispatched with cave tribes to open the route.
s0181.idiomatic: On jimao day bandits in Luoshi Ghost Country caused trouble and the roads of Si and Bo were blocked; 1,000 troops were sent with cave tribes to open the route.

s0182.literal: On jiashen day relay households were added in Gan Prefecture; an edict directed that they be drafted from princely household registers.
s0182.idiomatic: On jiashen day relay households were added in Gan Prefecture; an edict directed that they be drafted from princely household registers.

s0183.literal: On yiyou day an order directed that commoners who had evaded corvée by registering as artisan households be restored to commoner status.
s0183.idiomatic: On yiyou day an order directed that commoners who had evaded corvée by registering as artisan households be restored to commoner status.

s0184.literal: Huai-xi pacification commissioner Angir requested that soldiers garrison-farm; Atahai and others said mobilizing militia was inconvenient and that commoners willing to farm should be recruited to do so, with rent remitted for three years; this was approved.
s0184.idiomatic: Huai-xi pacification commissioner Angir asked that soldiers garrison-farm; Atahai and others said mobilizing militia was inconvenient and that willing commoners should be recruited to farm instead, with rent remitted for three years; the request was approved.

s0185.literal: On dinghai day an edict again directed that civilian administrators also administer the ordu of the various armies.
s0185.idiomatic: On dinghai day an edict again directed that civilian administrators also administer the ordu of the various armies.

s0186.literal: On wuzi day one thousand five hundred troops from the campaign against Yekebuxue were returned to Tahai to garrison the Eight Fan and Luodian.
s0186.idiomatic: On wuzi day 1,500 troops from the campaign against Yekebuxue were returned to Tahai to garrison the Eight Fan and Luodian.

s0187.literal: On renchen day Chen Guilong seized Zhangzhou and rebelled; Suodu led troops to suppress him, and Guilong fled into a She stockade.
s0187.idiomatic: On renchen day Chen Guilong seized Zhangzhou and rebelled; Suodu led troops against him, and Guilong fled into a She stockade.

s0188.literal: On jiawu day the rebuilt Imperial Ancestral Temple at Dadu was completed; spirit tablets were reverently moved from the old temple to the side chamber, and the grand offering rite was then performed.
s0188.idiomatic: On jiawu day the rebuilt Imperial Ancestral Temple at Dadu was completed; spirit tablets were moved from the old temple to the side chamber, and the grand offering rite was then performed.

s0189.literal: The Protectorate General of the Pacified North was established in Uyghur territory, with Tuotuoemur and others placed in charge.
s0189.idiomatic: The Protectorate General of the Pacified North was established in Uyghur territory, with Tuotuoemur and others placed in charge.

s0190.literal: On bingshen day troops added in Liaodong Route had exchanged wives and children for horses; an edict directed that they be redeemed with the taxes they owed.
s0190.idiomatic: On bingshen day troops added in Liaodong Route had exchanged wives and children for horses; an edict directed that they be redeemed with the taxes they owed.

s0191.literal: An edict ordered five hundred copies of Imperial Preceptor 'Phags-pa's newly translated 《Precept Text》 carved on blocks and printed, to be issued to monks on all routes.
s0191.idiomatic: An edict ordered 500 copies of Imperial Preceptor 'Phags-pa's newly translated 《Precept Text》 carved on blocks and printed for issue to monks on all routes.

s0192.literal: Left grand councillor Aju toured the western frontier and died of illness at Bieshibali.
s0192.idiomatic: Left grand councillor Aju toured the western frontier and died of illness at Bieshibali.

s0193.literal: An edict declared that those who seized without authority the abandoned fields of displaced Jiangnan commoners were guilty.
s0193.idiomatic: An edict declared that those who seized without authority the abandoned fields of displaced Jiangnan commoners were guilty.

s0194.literal: The shrine of the Huai River at Mount Tongbai was repaired.
s0194.idiomatic: The shrine of the Huai River at Mount Tongbai was repaired.

s0195.literal: Because Xu Daoqi, forty-third-generation patriarch of the Shangqing lineage on Mount Sanmao, had prayers answered, he was ordered separately to head Daoism.
s0195.idiomatic: Because Xu Daoqi, forty-third-generation patriarch of the Shangqing lineage on Mount Sanmao, had prayers answered, he was ordered separately to head Daoism.

s0196.literal: Annam presented tame elephants as tribute.
s0196.idiomatic: Annam presented tame elephants as tribute.

s0197.literal: Cave chieftains were granted silver, paper currency, and clothing in graded amounts.
s0197.idiomatic: Cave chieftains received silver, paper currency, and clothing in graded amounts.

s0198.literal: Famine relief was given to the hungry in Gongchang, Changde, and other routes, and their corvée was also remitted.
s0198.idiomatic: Famine relief was given to the hungry in Gongchang, Changde, and other routes, and their corvée was also remitted.

s0199.literal: The Guard Office was changed to a metropolitan commander's office;
s0199.idiomatic: The Guard Office was changed to a metropolitan commander's office;

s0200.literal: the Director of Palace Accouterments was raised to rank three;
s0200.idiomatic: the Director of Palace Accouterments was raised to rank three;
